specs.title: Risk score and deposit gating
specs.why: Turning no-show history into an automatic deposit requirement is the payoff for tracking it.
specs.scope: Compute a client risk score from no-show history and recency. High-risk clients must pay a deposit before their slot is confirmed. Thresholds configurable per tenant.
tasks: Booking flow enforces a deposit for high-risk clients
acceptance: The score is deterministic for the same inputs
A high-risk booking is blocked until the deposit is paid
The owner can override per booking

specs.title: Waitlist auto-fill
specs.why: Refilling cancelled slots automatically recovers revenue the merchant would otherwise lose.
specs.scope: When a booking cancels, notify waitlisted clients in order over WhatsApp with a payment link. First to pay keeps the slot. Must be race-safe.
tasks: Enrollment from the public page and the agent
Cancel trigger dispatches to the waitlist
Atomic slot claim with a database constraint
acceptance: Only one waitlist client can claim the slot
Notifications go out in enrollment order
An unclaimed slot reopens after 30 minutes
